title: I made a Star Fox 64–style game where AI animal mercenaries fight the stock market
author: Thereturn89
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/vznab1aj5fyg1.png?width=1086&format=png&auto=webp&s=9d528ef75dc20d3b585c33246045a3cd716dd582

So I accidentally made a game where:



\- a honey badger solves problems by ramming them

\- an octopus runs eight business strategies at once

\- an elephant refuses to launch without safety approval

\- a mantis shrimp sees “alternative timelines”

\- and an ant just quietly delivers destruction at scale



It’s basically Star Fox 64… if the pilots were AI personalities arguing about markets mid-mission.



You fly through space blowing up “Short Seller” fleets, dodging debris, and trying to survive increasingly questionable financial decisions.



There’s also a news anchor calmly reporting on total economic collapse while you’re causing it.



I made it as a browser game, so you can just jump in:



👉 [https://star-mercenaries-64.pages.dev/](https://star-mercenaries-64.pages.dev/)



Would genuinely love feedback — especially on the controls and feel. Trying to nail that tight N64 arcade vibe.



Also yes, the team argues with each other the entire time.

  
If anyone played Star Fox 64 growing up — that’s exactly the feel I’m chasing.



Still tuning:

\- ship movement (arcade vs floaty)

\- hit feedback / explosions

\- UI readability



Any feedback helps a ton 🙏
